organization_identity.requiredEvidence: Current organization record and, if legal identity is claimed, official registration evidence bound to the tenant ID.
organization_identity.authoritativeSource: Tenant organization record and official registration evidence.
organization_identity.acceptanceTest: Independent checker matches the name and tenant identifier to the retained authoritative record.
organization_identity.developmentImpact: Display-label use is permitted after database reconciliation.
organization_identity.integrationImpact: No blocker while tenant IDs remain authoritative.
organization_identity.productionImpact: Does not establish legal identity without verified registration evidence.

migration_authority.accountableOwner: Database change owner, operator, and independent checker
migration_authority.requiredEvidence: Authenticated subject IDs, appointments, conflict declaration, target proof, final evidence hashes, separate signatures, and ordered timestamps.
migration_authority.authoritativeSource: Enterprise identity, change-approval, and migration evidence systems.
migration_authority.acceptanceTest: Operator and checker are distinct; target and hashes match; checker signs after final execution evidence.
migration_authority.developmentImpact: Static and non-destructive development checks may continue.
migration_authority.integrationImpact: No destructive or production execution authority is granted.

workflow_appointments.requiredEvidence: Stable subject IDs and effective appointments for the exact role, organization, decision, and period.
workflow_appointments.acceptanceTest: Independent checker verifies appointment scope, effective dates, and segregation of duties.
workflow_appointments.developmentImpact: Seeded personas may exercise development workflows.
workflow_appointments.integrationImpact: Fail-closed maker-checker integration testing may continue.
workflow_appointments.productionImpact: No production decision authority is established.

identity_conflict_resolution.accountableOwner: HRIS, IAM, and workflow authority owners
identity_conflict_resolution.requiredEvidence: Stable subject IDs, authoritative names, appointments, effective dates, and independent verification.
identity_conflict_resolution.authoritativeSource: Enterprise IAM, HRIS, and authority register.
identity_conflict_resolution.acceptanceTest: The conflict is resolved without name-only matching or silent subject merging.
identity_conflict_resolution.developmentImpact: Existing distinct seeded personas may continue for development tests.
identity_conflict_resolution.integrationImpact: The conflict must remain visible in evidence exports.
identity_conflict_resolution.productionImpact: Blocks reliance on the conflicting identity as an approver or checker.

product_approval.accountableOwner: Product governance owner and authorized product approver
product_approval.requiredEvidence: Authenticated identity, appointment, scope, signature, timestamp, and exact candidate hash.
product_approval.authoritativeSource: Product governance and enterprise approval records.
product_approval.acceptanceTest: Independent checker verifies appointment and signature against the exact frozen artifact hash.
product_approval.developmentImpact: Candidate persona may exercise development approval tests.
product_approval.integrationImpact: No production authority is inferred from seed data or DOCX metadata.

controller_approval.accountableOwner: Finance governance owner and authorized controller
controller_approval.requiredEvidence: Authenticated identity, verified professional capacity, appointment, scope, conflict declaration, signature, and timestamp.
controller_approval.authoritativeSource: Finance governance, HRIS, and enterprise approval records.
controller_approval.acceptanceTest: Independent checker verifies capacity, appointment, signature, and separation from the maker.
controller_approval.developmentImpact: Candidate persona may exercise development approval workflows.
controller_approval.integrationImpact: Fail-closed control integration testing may continue.

scratch_target_verification.requiredEvidence: Verified host, database, schema, environment, and non-production boundary.
scratch_target_verification.authoritativeSource: Database connection preflight and target-verification artifact.
scratch_target_verification.acceptanceTest: All non-secret target coordinates match the retained preflight hash before any operation.
scratch_target_verification.developmentImpact: A verified scratch target may support development rehearsal.
scratch_target_verification.integrationImpact: It must remain isolated from public and production schemas.

restore_rehearsal.accountableOwner: Database recovery operator and independent checker
restore_rehearsal.requiredEvidence: Verified scratch target, timestamped restore run, integrity checks, result, and independent verification.
restore_rehearsal.authoritativeSource: Controlled restore execution and database verification artifacts.
restore_rehearsal.acceptanceTest: Restore succeeds on a verified non-production target and the checker validates integrity from retained hashes.
restore_rehearsal.developmentImpact: Documentation and dry-run validation may continue.
restore_rehearsal.integrationImpact: Recovery readiness remains unproven until execution evidence exists.

production_authorization.accountableOwner: Authorized product, finance, security, compliance, and release approvers
production_authorization.requiredEvidence: Completed release evidence, verified appointments, authentic signatures, qualified review, external prerequisites, and passing production gates bound to one frozen candidate.
production_authorization.authoritativeSource: Independent release decision and applicable external authority evidence.
production_authorization.acceptanceTest: Every mandatory production gate passes without override and independent approvers sign after the final evidence timestamp.
production_authorization.developmentImpact: No effect; development is controlled by a separate gate.
production_authorization.integrationImpact: Core integration remains non-production and fail-closed.

qualified_country_pack_review.accountableOwner: Compliance/legal owner and appointed independent Cameroon reviewer
qualified_country_pack_review.requiredEvidence: Verified identity, professional capacity, qualification reference, scope, conflict declaration, review window, recomputed source digests, family decisions, tie-out hashes, signature, and independent checker record.
qualified_country_pack_review.authoritativeSource: Qualified signed review decision bound to retained official sources and the frozen country-pack candidate.
qualified_country_pack_review.acceptanceTest: Qualified-review preflight and statutory production gate pass for the same candidate without override.
qualified_country_pack_review.developmentImpact: Development and sandbox work may continue fail-closed.
qualified_country_pack_review.integrationImpact: Production activation and legal-effect execution remain disabled.
qualified_country_pack_review.productionImpact: Blocks statutory, fiscal, payroll, and CNPS production reliance.

qualified_accounting_review.accountableOwner: Finance governance owner and appointed qualified accounting reviewer
qualified_accounting_review.requiredEvidence: Verified qualification, appointment, scope, conflict declaration, reviewed evidence, decision, signature, and independent check.
qualified_accounting_review.acceptanceTest: Reviewer capacity and every conclusion are independently verified against the frozen evidence set.
qualified_accounting_review.developmentImpact: Accounting workflow development may continue with non-certification labels.
qualified_accounting_review.integrationImpact: No certified accounting conclusion may be exposed.

external_authority_conformance.accountableOwner: DGI/MINFI liaison, security owner, integration owner, and qualified fiscal reviewer
external_authority_conformance.requiredEvidence: Applicable official contract or decision, endpoints, credential process, sandbox conformance, response fixtures, signature/transport controls, scope, date, and retained hashes.
external_authority_conformance.authoritativeSource: Official authority channels and independently verified conformance evidence.
external_authority_conformance.acceptanceTest: Every applicable external-authority checklist row passes and an independent checker verifies origin, applicability, scope, signatures, and hashes.

identityConflicts.reason: The working form and repository prefill use different names for checker-related authority. Name matching cannot establish subject identity.
identityConflicts.requiredResolution: Provide stable subject IDs, appointments, effective dates, and independent authority-register verification. Do not merge the names automatically.

identityConflicts.reason: The G1 roster contains a spelling variant and proposes the product approver as a qualified country-pack reviewer without qualification evidence.
identityConflicts.requiredResolution: Verify the stable subject ID, correct spelling, each separate appointment, professional capacity, scope, and conflict declaration.

nonClaims: This register is a transcription and classification artifact, not an approval.
Typed names, DOCX metadata, seeded users, database roles, and blank signature fields are not authentic signatures or appointments.
Development readiness and core integration readiness are separate from statutory, fiscal, payroll, regulator, or production approval.
Engineering cannot supply qualified legal/accounting conclusions or external authority evidence.
